name: exploded-view
title: Exploded View
description: An isometric stack of slabs springs apart with leader lines and labels, holds, then clicks back together.
useWhen: An architecture or a product stack should be explained layer by layer, such as interface, engine, storage and hardware.
One layer of a system is the point of the story and should be called out in brand color.
avoidWhen: The object should turn to show its front and back rather than come apart: use turntable.
The layers are numbers to compare rather than parts of one thing: use animated-bar-chart.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Labels
variables.description: One label per slab, top slab first, comma separated.

variables.label: Highlight
variables.description: Index of the highlighted slab, counted from the top (0 is the top slab).

variables.label: Highlight top
variables.description: Top face of the highlighted slab.

variables.label: Highlight left
variables.description: Left face of the highlighted slab.

variables.label: Highlight right
variables.description: Right face of the highlighted slab.
